subject: Re: HD-4471 — WC-12 credential handoff
body: 4/5 — polite rep. I've been back and forth with the packet scanner for two weeks about the Wi-Fi field and they still have it held. Their dispute desk can see it's tied to the review under the WC-12 onboarding record, and the one thing they keep asking for is the reference label your system shows for that case — they say nothing can match or release without it. Could you check the WC-12 onboarding record and make sure the reply on my ticket carries that reference? It's the last piece standing between me and the packet.
